property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any newOwner address (including the zero address), after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner() getter equals newOwner; the mutant that removes the assignment leaves owner unchanged and thus violates this property for some fuzzed newOwner inputs.
change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with a no-op (remove assignment), so transferOwnership no longer updates owner.
